findings.note: Coward tied his season high with 23 points in 33 minutes on Nov. 14 while Ty Jerome (hip) and Zach Edey (ankle) were out, and he is shooting 43.5% from three. If either teammate is still out against Cleveland, his usage could stay high; no status for this game was found.

NBA.com lists Coward at 14.1 PPG, below the 15.5 line, as a starter. In his last five games he scored 18, 23, 14, 15 and 3 in 27 to 33 minutes, so he went over in each of his two most recent games and under in the three before that.

As of Nov. 12, Coward was averaging 12.8 points per game, and much of his value came from rebounds, threes and steals rather than heavy scoring. That supports a points total below 15.5, though he has scored more since then.
